summary: Frontend-only test of new AI Coach section on FitForge dashboard. PIN login (858608) works. AI Coach section renders correctly between DataCards and Body Composition. All 4 tabs (Weekly Coach, Plateau Check, Photo Compare, Apple Health) render, are clickable, and swap panels as expected. Weekly Coach and Plateau tabs show correct copy + action buttons. Photo Compare shows the '<2 photos' empty state. Apple Health tab renders BLANK because the Python backend doesn't expose /api/health-sync/info (404) and the panel is gated on syncInfo being non-null. This matches the request's expected behavior but is a poor UX (clicking the tab appears to do nothing).

ui_bugs.issue: Panel renders completely empty when syncInfo is null (Python backend returns 404 on /api/health-sync/info). Users clicking the tab see nothing. Recommend adding an empty/error fallback UI so the tab body is never blank.

action_items: Add fallback empty/error state to Apple Health tab in AICoach.jsx so it doesn't render blank when syncInfo is null.

Note: existing 404s on /api/ai/latest/weekly_coach, /api/ai/latest/plateau_detect, /api/health-sync/info are silently swallowed via .catch — expected per request (endpoints only on Vercel Node backend).
critical_code_review_comments: AICoach.jsx line 274: '{tab === \'health\' && syncInfo && (...)}' will render nothing when syncInfo is null. Should render an empty-state/error instead.
AICoach.jsx uses alert() for error UX (lines 39,48,58). Consider a toast component consistent with rest of app.
authAxios is recreated on every render (line 23). Move into useMemo or module scope to avoid unnecessary re-instantiation.
Chart console warnings observed: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — recharts container has 0-dim parent somewhere on dashboard.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested UI checks passed; Apple Health blank state is expected)

context_for_next_testing_agent: AI endpoints only exist in /app/api/index.js (Vercel Node), not server.py. Any /api/ai/* or /api/health-sync/* calls return 404 in local preview — do NOT flag as bugs. Apple Health tab blank behavior is by-design guard but poor UX.
